## ColumnDefinition.unsigned() method

Mark the column unsigned.

**Signature:**

```typescript
unsigned(value?: boolean): this;
```

## Remarks

Postgres and sqlite have no unsigned integers, so this is honoured on MySQL only — it is a storage hint, never a portable constraint.
